proposedFix: In the completion branch, build update values without ':pending' (e.g. {k: v for k, v in values.items() if k != ':pending'}), and add a unit test with a fake table that rejects unused ExpressionAttributeValues/Names, as DynamoDB does. reproduction: Safe DynamoDB probe on a nonexistent diagnostic key with the identical update/condition expressions: with ':pending' -> ValidationException (unused :pending); without it -> ConditionalCheckFailedException (no item written).
rootCause: backend/src/legaldesk/idp/ocr.py:228 builds ExpressionAttributeValues with ':pending'; the completion branch (ocr.py:245-251) reuses them in update_item whose expressions never reference ':pending'. DynamoDB rejects the request with ValidationException 'Value provided in ExpressionAttributeValues unused in expressions: keys: {:pending}', which put() wraps as OCRContractError. Every Textract completion callback therefore fails deterministically; production OCR continuation cannot complete.
